results.name: QC, RTG and ES illustrations on the fleet cards, group headers and the KPI tile (normal and TV): in-house inline SVG with the recognisable parts (QC: boom, A-frame, forestays, backstay, legs, portal, machinery house, trolley, cab, ropes, spreader, container; RTG: legs, girder, trolley, cab, spreader, container rows, tyres, e-house; ES: mast, side-pick spreader, empty container, cab, counterweight, wheels), each card shows its own type, CICT red on QC/RTG structure, no images, external references, gradients or canvases; QC proportions follow the drawing (boom tip to waterside leg : rail gauge = 75.9 : 30 within 5 %)

Blink: every active Breakdown card pulses rose (2.5 s, 0.4 flashes/s) and every Maintenance card amber (3.5 s, 0.29 flashes/s), both below 3 flashes per second, with different colours, rhythm and stripe pattern (solid / dashed); Ready for OPS and Unreported never blink; status stays as icon + text badge and in the accessible name; the blink changes no layout (card boxes identical at 0, 25, 50, 75 % of the cycle); peak colours differ in hue from each other (>= 40 degrees) and from the CICT paint red; also in TV mode

Reduced motion, Pause and motion=off: with prefers-reduced-motion the blinking cards show a steady highlighted fill and ring (no animation) in normal and TV mode; the Pause blinking control (aria-pressed) gives the same steady state and Resume restores the blink; ?motion=off starts paused with the control disabled; the legend and badges keep the meaning without colour

Flat pastel professional EQ Fleet: light neutral page, white rounded cards and KPI tiles with soft shadows, a six-tile KPI row (active with type illustrations, Ready-for-OPS share, four status tiles that filter), restrained colours; no gradients, glow (text-shadow), backdrop blur, neon or glass anywhere on the page; sans-serif type; U1-C02 density kept (cards <= 60 px, whole fleet on one 1366x768 screen); status colours distinct from CICT paint red
